title: Theater glamour and his mother's secret marriage
summary: He liked everything about the theaters; Helen and Stanley Dance say his mother may have married in secret to settle him down.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, I take it, Freddie, that this theater thing -- Did the sort of glamour side of that appeal to you or was it --
Did strike you then, or not? Or was it just purely the music and the dancing?
No. I liked everything about it. You know, it was exciting to me.
The lights, and what they were doing on stage, and how they did it. I used to just go and watch them, you know, attentively and watch.
Were you quiet, on the whole?
Yeah. I don't remember whether I was or not.
You know, some kids are all eyes, and taking everything but they don't have that much to say.
No, well, you know, my mother used to have a problem -- like every time she'd come home there was always something that I did. (laugh) So, I wouldn't say that I was quiet.
Because every time that she came home there was always Freddie did this and Freddie did (tape ends)
Because every time that she came home there was always (PAUSE)
You know I'm always afraid I forgot to turn the mike on.

Well, I just want to record the fact that Freddie says he thinks that's one of the reasons why maybe his mother got married in secret, because she got tired of always coming home and having the neighbors and different people say "Freddie did this, and Freddie did that". (laugh)
